name: The Gardener
source:
Your friend died in the spring and was buried in the soft grass. Drinking next to his grave, you meet a monster and must answer his call.

Experience a short visual novel about trans grief and the monster you must reckon with.

[From [url=https://dacuriblue.itch.io/thegardener]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友在春天去世了，被埋在柔软的草丛中。在他的坟墓旁喝酒时，你遇到了一个怪物，必须回应他的召唤。

体验一部关于跨性别者悲伤和你必须面对的怪物的简短视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://dacuriblue.itch.io/thegardener]Itch.io[/url]]
